title: Procedure runs need a Papyrus checkout: the installed packages ship no procedures/, corpora/ or tactus
description: start_cloud_procedure_run resolves PAPYRUS_ROOT/procedures and corpora/..., prepends ../Tactus and src to PYTHONPATH, and shells out to tactus run. A site repository that installs papyrus-newsroom from PyPI and @anthusai/papyrus from npm (Distinctive-web on 5.7.0) has none of these: no .tac files, no corpora JSON, and no tactus package in the Python environment. Procedure runs should work from an installed site: tactus as a dependency of papyrus-newsroom (or an extra), run files materialized from the stored ProcedureVersion, no sibling checkouts.
